android.desc:
**WorldFactbook – Explore Countries, Flags & Geography Games**

Discover the world through countries, flags, capitals, languages, and fun geography challenges.

WorldFactbook is a colorful, easy-to-use learning app for curious explorers, students, travelers, and geography lovers. Search countries, save your favorites, view national flags, and explore useful country facts in a clean, modern experience.

Turn learning into play with a growing collection of offline geography mini games. Challenge yourself to recognize flags, match countries, rebuild flag puzzles, test your knowledge of capitals, and discover the languages spoken around the world.

Features:

- Explore a searchable directory of countries
- View beautifully presented national flags and country information
- Learn country facts, geography details, and languages
- Save countries to your personal Favorites list
- Enjoy a colorful, modern, easy-to-read interface
- Play Guess the Flag in a fast-paced 60-second challenge
- Play Flag Connect, Flag Memory, and Flag Puzzle
- Play Country Match by choosing the correct flag for each country
- Test your knowledge with Capital Quiz
- Learn about world languages with Language Match
- Choose difficulty levels in selected games
- Enjoy sound feedback and satisfying interactions during gameplay
- Track personal best scores and game progress
- Review Flag Quiz results in the Game History leaderboard, ranked by score
- Play offline with built-in country data for everyday learning

Whether you are preparing for a geography quiz, planning your next trip, helping children learn about the world, or simply enjoying a quick brain challenge, WorldFactbook makes discovering countries fun, visual, and accessible.
